stem: Voltmarkt's finance director asks about Business Care, Voltmarkt's device-support subscription for small offices: "Why did MRR grow by only €300 in October when we signed €1,000 of new business?" Which calculation answers this question?

options.text: 100 × a cohort's MRR now / its MRR 12 months ago
October MRR / businesses active in October
Split the MRR change into new, expansion, reactivation, contraction and churn
100 × businesses that cancelled in October / businesses active at the start of October
